@@ -509,6 +509,7 @@
 			<param index="1" name="value" type="Variant" />
 			<description>
 				Sets the value of the element at the given [param key] to the given [param value]. This is the same as using the [code][][/code] operator ([code]dict[key] = value[/code]).
+				Returns [code]true[/code] if the value is set successfully, otherwise returns [code]false[/code]. This can occur if the dictionary is read-only, or if the given arguments don't match the dictionary's types.
body:
"_Returns `true` if the value is set successfully_" and "_This can occur_" together imply that there's also other occasions this method returns `false`. This can be misinterpreted(?) to imply there's other occasions in which this occurs.

Whenever the method returns `false` it is actually **always** considered an error, as it is printed as such.
Maybe:
```suggestion
				Returns [code]true[/code] if the value is set successfully. Fails and returns [code]false[/code] if the dictionary is read-only, or if the given arguments don't match the dictionary's types.
```
or
```suggestion
				Returns [code]true[/code] if the value is set successfully. Fails and returns [code]false[/code] if the dictionary is read-only, or if [param key] and [param value] don't match the dictionary's types.
```
Or similar. I'd also personally merge this extra remark with the first line.
